text_to_image_prompt:
Create ONE finished photographic storyboard contact sheet, exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows of twelve equally sized portrait frames, read left to right and top to bottom. Overall portrait 3:4 canvas1086x1448, clean thin cream gutters and tiny panel numbers01-12 only. Every frame is a real warm natural lifestyle photograph, genuine fur and textiles, soft cream/ivory and pale oak surroundings, gentle daylight indoors and coherent warm evening light when specified. The same compact golden-orange shorthaired tabby kitten in every panel, very round plush cheeks, ivory muzzle/chin/chest, huge round dark-olive eyes and black pupils, tiny pink nose, fine white whiskers and delicate tabby stripes; real rounded feline paws, no extra limbs, human fingers on cat or floating tools. Home garment when indicated: tiny near-square cream linen chest bib nested between forelegs, blue fish pocket applique, bib width around half chest, bottom above belly with legs and belly fur exposed. Forelegs occlude bib side edges. Narrow curved neck loop and separate lower chest band with a tiny back knot and short ties; no crossed back harness. Exterior outfit A when specified: yellow short-sleeve tee, blue denim bib overalls, tan wooden buttons and red knitted bow. Outfit B: white sailor cap with plain navy band, pale-blue short-sleeve shirt with navy square sailor collar and two white stripes, white front buttons and plain navy cat trousers with a tail opening; no necktie or hat emblem. Small white pleated chef toque only in cooking scenes where indicated. Cleaning garment only where specified: plain pale-blue round-neck short smock with elastic sleeve cuffs, front opening, no pockets, navy sailor collar or layered home bib. Owner camera POV whenever described, only the explicitly needed zero to two anatomically connected hands with powder-blue white-piped pajama cuffs enter from camera-bottom; no visible owner face, hair, torso, reflection or detached third arm. In solo shopping, cooking and household chores no helping human hands; supermarket clerk is a separate adult NPC only in specified frames. One frozen action per frame, alternatives are separate frames, not repeated cats or mixed branch outcomes. English phone UI when indicated, no dialogue captions, story title, balloons or control buttons. The following Chinese shot directions are production instructions, never render them as captions. Preserve the depicted wardrobe and pose separately for each numbered frame.

Panel01: 闹钟响 — 第一视角关闹钟，最多一只手伸向床头手机。 Composition: Owner POV from ivory bed, powder-blue pajama sleeve reaching toward a phone on an oak bedside table, sleepy morning light; no cat yet.
Panel02: 小猫拦住被角 — 咪压住被角，闭嘴观察，台词开始才响应口型。 Composition: Approved bedside composition: golden kitten in short cream apron with blue fish patch sits on ivory duvet, two forepaws pinning duvet, eyes looking at owner, mouth closed before speaking.
Panel03: 确认休假 — 主人第一视角查看早已确认的休假，不是临时旷工。 Composition: POV pajama-clad hand holding phone beside the cat, blank calendar-shaped screen reserved for post-production; cat listening with closed mouth.
Panel04: 爪子托付 — I01-A：手掌摊开接住咪的一只前爪。 Composition: POV owner open palm resting on quilt, kitten forepaw hovering just above it, real cat paw and correct five-finger human hand.
Panel05: 先抱一下 — I01-B：主人俯视主动贴近的咪，只见自己的袖口和前臂。 Composition: POV two blue-sleeved arms open above duvet, kitten leaning toward sleeve, forehead not yet touching; face of woman outside frame.
Panel06: 拖鞋摆反 — 咪独自把摆反的一只拖鞋转正。 Composition: Downward owner POV at bedroom threshold, blue pajama trouser hems, two cream slippers both pointing sideways, kitten looking between slippers and owner feet.
Panel07: 小推车送早餐 — 用小车送吐司、香蕉、温水，猫自己的早餐分开。 Composition: POV seated at oak breakfast table, kitten behind a low pale-wood trolley with toast plate, banana and water, stable broad step stool beside table.
Panel08: 果酱露馅 — 咪发现爪背沾了果酱，想藏起来。 Composition: Closer POV at table, kitten in apron with a tiny red jam smudge on furry forepaw, toast plate on table; cat follows owner gaze with mouth closed.
Panel09: 擦净小爪 — 仅两只人手：左手托猫爪，右手用湿巾擦，双手从镜头方向伸入。 Composition: POV adult hand holding damp wipe beside jam-marked kitten paw, all paws supported on tabletop edge.
Panel10: 一起吃早饭 — 第一视角用餐，咪吃自己的食碗。 Composition: Owner POV toast in hand foreground, kitten seated opposite with its own small food bowl, calm morning window light.
Panel11: 拉链没开 — 咪先打开袋子拉链再装钥匙。 Composition: Cat-height view near entry: kitten beside zipped small beige cloth bag, key with fabric loop lying on floor outside it, paws empty.
Panel12: 两套完整外出服 — 床边展示两套完整外出服，衔接下一集选择。 Composition: POV on bed edge: cream knit vest and sage kitten overalls on owner blue-pajama lap; bare-furred cat facing them, apron hanging on low hook in background.
reproduction_note: 独立文生图提示词根据已确认成图及当前镜头索引整理；实际原图曾使用身份参考与局部返修，仅文字未验证近乎一致。原始生成提示词、真实生成日期和审图备注另行保留。

original_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the existing 12-frame storyboard EDIT TARGET; image 2 is the APPROVED kitten and short bib original; image 3 is the physical FRONT/SIDE/BACK bib construction reference. Return the complete same 4 columns x 3 rows storyboard, twelve numbered portrait panels 01-12, photographic warm domestic style, same compositions and plot except requested changes. Preserve kitten face, orange markings, real rounded paws, props, panel numbering and warm lighting.
GLOBAL WARDROBE CORRECTION in EVERY visible bib: exact compact cream linen blue-fish CHEST BIB, not kitchen apron. Panel near-square, width about HALF chest width, height equal to width, nestled BETWEEN upper forelegs. Bottom ends above belly, leaving fluffy lower belly and all legs exposed. Never extend fabric when kitten stands, reclines, raises arms or wears chef hat. Pocket takes most of compact panel with ONE blue fish. No extra lower skirt, duplicate pocket, long bib or smock-like front. Forelegs overlap side edges realistically. Back construction exactly reference3: narrow curved neck loop AND separate lower ribcage band tied with small bow and short tails, orange fur between; NO X, diagonal back harness or neck bow. Side fastening subtle not a large blue strap. No humans except existing legitimate owner POV hands; never add owner's face, hair or body.
ONLY12: correct folded spare sailor set on bed to exact reference4 pale blue shirt navy square sailor collar two white stripes, white buttons, NO dark necktie, plain navy trousers, white cap plain navy band NO logo. Keep yellow outfit and redbow. Light correction all visible home bibs to compact original proportions if needed, never lower belly. Preserve ALL twelve compositions/actions especially09 EXACTLY TWO owner hands cleaning ONE kitten paw, and face/bed/lighting. No third hand.
